title: Curse of Grudge
description: A cursed enchantment that makes mined blocks remember and strike back.
body:
# Curse of Grudge

Curse of Grudge adds a cursed enchantment to Minecraft.

When a player repeatedly mines the same type of block with a tool carrying this curse, nearby matching blocks may remember the player, break free from the world, and attack the miner as vengeful blocks.

## Features

- Adds the Curse of Grudge enchantment.
- Mining repeated block types can trigger a grudge reaction.
- Nearby matching blocks can become hostile vengeful blocks.
- Vengeful blocks physically attack the player instead of simply dealing hidden damage.
- Includes English and Simplified Chinese language files.
- Designed for Forge 1.20.1.

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1
- Forge 47.4.15 or newer
- Required on both client and server

## Notes

This mod is intended for survival challenges, cursed-tool videos, horror-style Minecraft experiments, and short-form mod showcase content.

# 中文说明

《Curse of Grudge / 记仇》会给 Minecraft 添加一个诅咒附魔。

当玩家使用带有这个诅咒的工具反复挖掘同一种方块时，附近相同类型的方块可能会“记住”玩家，从原本的位置脱离出来，并变成会攻击玩家的怨念方块。

适合用来制作生存挑战、诅咒工具、矿石复仇、恐怖规则类 Minecraft 视频。
